                    "seed": seed,
                    "ckpt_type": ckpt_type,
                    "ckpt_dir": str(ckpt_dir),
                    "tag": f"bm25_s{seed}_{ckpt_type}",
                })

    return checkpoints


def run_eval(ckpt_dir, subset_flag, subset_file, output_path):
    if Path(output_path).exists():
        print(f"  SKIP (cached): {Path(output_path).name}")
        with open(output_path) as f:
            return json.load(f)

    cmd = [
        sys.executable, str(SCRIPTS_DIR / "evaluate_pool50.py"),
        "--ckpt-dir", ckpt_dir,
        "--model-name", MODEL_NAME,
        "--val-file", VAL_FILE,
        "--pool-size", str(POOL_SIZE),
        "--device", DEVICE,
        f"--{subset_flag}", subset_file,
        "--output", output_path,
    ]
    print(f"  CMD: evaluate_pool50.py --{subset_flag} ... --output {Path(output_path).name}", flush=True)
    result = subprocess.run(cmd)
    if result.returncode != 0:
        print(f"  ERROR: eval failed for {ckpt_dir}", flush=True)
        return None

    if Path(output_path).exists():
        with open(output_path) as f:
            return json.load(f)
    return None


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    os.makedirs(RESULTS_DIR, exist_ok=True)
    sel_file = f"{SPLIT_DIR}/selection_indices.txt"
    test_file = f"{SPLIT_DIR}/test_indices.txt"

    if not Path(sel_file).exists():
        print("=== Phase 0: Generating query splits ===", flush=True)
        subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(SCRIPTS_DIR / "generate_query_split.py")], check=True)

    with open(sel_file) as f:
        n_sel = sum(1 for line in f if line.strip())
    with open(test_file) as f:
        n_test = sum(1 for line in f if line.strip())
    print(f"Splits: {n_sel} selection + {n_test} test\n", flush=True)

    print("=== Phase 1: Finding checkpoints ===", flush=True)
    checkpoints = find_checkpoints()
    print(f"Found {len(checkpoints)} checkpoints:")
    for ckpt in checkpoints:
        print(f"  [{ckpt['ckpt_type']:<25}] {ckpt['strategy']}_s{ckpt['seed']}")

    if args.dry_run:
        print(f"\n[DRY-RUN] Would evaluate {len(checkpoints)} checkpoints. Exiting.")
        return

    # Phase 2: Selection set eval
    print(f"\n=== Phase 2: Selection set evaluation ({n_sel} samples) ===", flush=True)
    selection_results = {}
    for i, ckpt in enumerate(checkpoints):
        tag = ckpt["tag"]
        out = f"{RESULTS_DIR}/selection_{tag}.json"
        print(f"\n[{i+1}/{len(checkpoints)}] {tag}", flush=True)
        metrics = run_eval(ckpt["ckpt_dir"], "selection-set", sel_file, out)
        if metrics:
            selection_results[tag] = {
                **ckpt,
                "selection_r1": metrics["recall@1"],
                "selection_r5": metrics.get("recall@5", 0),
            }

    # Phase 3: Select best per strategy
    print(f"\n=== Phase 3: Checkpoint selection (max selection R@1) ===", flush=True)
    best_per_strategy = {}
    for strategy in STRATEGIES + ["bm25"]:
        candidates = {k: v for k, v in selection_results.items()
                      if v["strategy"] == strategy}
        if not candidates:
            continue
        best_tag = max(candidates, key=lambda k: candidates[k]["selection_r1"])
        best = candidates[best_tag]
        best_per_strategy[strategy] = best
        print(f"  {strategy:<25} -> {best_tag} (sel R@1={best['selection_r1']:.4f})")

    # Phase 4: Test set eval
    print(f"\n=== Phase 4: Test set evaluation ({n_test} samples) ===", flush=True)
    final_results = {}
    for strategy, ckpt in best_per_strategy.items():
        tag = ckpt["tag"]
        out = f"{RESULTS_DIR}/test_{tag}.json"
        print(f"\n[{strategy}] {tag}", flush=True)
        metrics = run_eval(ckpt["ckpt_dir"], "test-set", test_file, out)
        if metrics:
            final_results[strategy] = {
                **ckpt,
                "test_r1": metrics["recall@1"],
                "test_r5": metrics.get("recall@5", 0),
                "test_r10": metrics.get("recall@10", 0),
            }

    # Summary
    print("\n" + "=" * 90)
    print("D062 RESULTS SUMMARY")
    print("=" * 90)
    print(f"{'Strategy':<22} {'Selected Checkpoint':<40} {'Sel R@1':<10} {'Test R@1':<10} {'Test R@5':<10}")
    print("-" * 90)
    for strategy in STRATEGIES + ["bm25"]:
        if strategy in final_results:
            r = final_results[strategy]
            print(f"{strategy:<22} {r['tag']:<40} "
                  f"{r['selection_r1']:<10.4f} {r['test_r1']:<10.4f} {r['test_r5']:<10.4f}")
    print("=" * 90)

    print("\nAll selection set results:")
    print(f"{'Tag':<45} {'Sel R@1':<10} {'Sel R@5':<10}")
    print("-" * 65)
    for tag in sorted(selection_results.keys()):
        r = selection_results[tag]
        marker = " <-- SELECTED" if any(b["tag"] == tag for b in best_per_strategy.values()) else ""
        print(f"{tag:<45} {r['selection_r1']:<10.4f} {r['selection_r5']:<10.4f}{marker}")

    summary = {
        "selection_results": {k: {kk: vv for kk, vv in v.items() if kk != "ckpt_dir"}
                              for k, v in selection_results.items()},
        "best_per_strategy": {k: v["tag"] for k, v in best_per_strategy.items()},
        "final_results": final_results,
    }
    summary_path = f"{RESULTS_DIR}/d062_summary.json"
    with open(summary_path, "w") as f:
        json.dump(summary, f, indent=2)
    print(f"\nSaved: {summary_path}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def load_model(ckpt_dir, model_name, device):
    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(ckpt_dir, trust_remote_code=True)
    config_path = Path(ckpt_dir) / "training_config.json"

    model = StructFuseEncoder(
        model_name=model_name,
        proj_dim=cfg.get("proj_dim", 256),
        use_lora=cfg.get("use_lora", True),
        lora_r=cfg.get("lora_r", 16),
        use_fusion_head=cfg.get("use_fusion_head", False),
